notes: Day 30 (Final page of Tikimt) concludes: St. Abraham the Hermit completes from page 112 (¶፬ joined with ¶፭ 'ወነበረ ውስተ ይእቲ በዓት እንዘ ይደመድ ከመዝ ፲ወ፯ተ ዓመተ...'), ¶፮-፰ life, warfare with demons, holy departure, ¶፱ doxology, Arke hymn for St. Abraham ('ሰላም እብል ለአብርሃም ነዳይ...'). Commemoration ¶፲ of the finding of the head of St. John the Baptist, Basilides, Birwasina, Martila, and Marcella, followed by second Arke hymn ('ሰላም ለይስሐቅ እምእግዚአብሔር ዘተክድነ...'). Colophon of Month of Tikimt ('ተፈጸመ ምንባብ ዘወርኃ ጥቅምት ። ወስብሐት ለእግዚአብሔር አሜን ።').
